Mentor Guide:
You can offer another character to become your Mentee by opening the Friend Manager (Alt+Y) and pressing the + button in the Mentorship tab.
For example, after becoming a Mentor, you can choose characters that would be your Mentees in the Mentorship tab.
Not every character can become a Mentor or a Mentee. A character can only become a Mentor if they had already gone through the Awakening and reached Lv. 105. A potential Mentee can't be higher than Lv. 104.
After a Mentee finishes the training, their Mentor can't take on new Mentees for a day. After discontinuing Mentorship for some other reason, a Mentor can't take on new Mentees for 2 days.
